items.description: Assumption 1 claims no rate limiting or pacing exists on the outbound path. DispatchGovernor in src/throttle.ts is a token-bucket pacer for the outbound webhook queue — the concept exists under another name, which a keyword search for 'rate limit' would miss.
Assumption 2 says three event names are in scope; EVENT_NAMES lists eight, and step 2 then budgets using eight. The spec contradicts itself and one of the two numbers drives the scope.
